description_en: Re-evaluates a specific rule or all rules in a compliance package
description_zh: 重新审计某条规则或某个合规包中的所有规则
kebab_example: aliyun config start-config-rule-evaluation --config-rule-id cr-9920626622af00350000 --revert-evaluation false --compliance-pack-id cp-ac16626622af00530000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartConfigRuleEvaluation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609222.html.

Specify either `CompliancePackId` or `ConfigRuleId`
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609222.html。

参数`CompliancePackId`和`ConfigRuleId`必须二选一
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restore evaluation results that were ignored. Valid values:

true: Restores ignored evaluation results.

false (default): Does not restore ignored evaluation results
parameters.help_zh:
是否恢复已忽略的评估结果。取值：

true：恢复已忽略的评估结果。

false（默认值）：不恢复已忽略的评估结果
parameters.name: revert_evaluation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/606968.html.

Specify either `CompliancePackId` or `ConfigRuleId`
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/606968.html。


参数`CompliancePackId`和`ConfigRuleId`必须二选一
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id
